Our approach blends top-tier technology with exceptional talent to optimize the monetization of digital screens in the physical world for our networks. We are seeking a seasoned and motivated product manager with an understanding of the programmatic adtech ecosystem and a collaborative approach to product development. Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.
That's where you come in.
The Riot Commercial Partnerships (RCP) team is responsible for identifying, building, and executing world-class partnerships with leading global and regional brands. Our mission is to drive revenue through strategic commercial collaborations that bring meaningful value to Riot’s fans - across Games, Entertainment, Esports, and Social Impact. For every product and event Riot creates, our premier partners help elevate the experience for millions of players and live audiences.
As an APAC Esports Partnership Manager, you will be a vital member of the APAC RCP team, helping drive the processes and procedures utilized to deliver for media rights partners and sponsors. In this role, you will be involved in all aspects of media rights partnership/sponsorship management, including licensing and contract management, broadcast and technical operations, partnership activation and integration, and data analytics and strategy.

Lead alignment across internal cross-functional teams and external partners through proactive communication to drive collaborative success.
Design and execute end-to-end operational workflows to ensure efficient and high-quality delivery of value to partners.
Develop and execute win-win strategies and actionable plans that deliver value to media partners and sponsors through esports services, while driving long-term fan satisfaction.
Conduct in-depth analysis of data to evaluate partnership performance and develop long-term strategies to maximize the value of Riot Esports partnerships.

4+ years of experience in partnership management, business development, account management or consulting
Self-starter with the eagerness and ability to handle multiple projects, prioritize work assignments, meet deadlines and work independently/collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, both internally and externally.
Strong analytical skills and background, with demonstrated ability to use data to power decision making.
Fluency in Korean and a professional working proficiency in English.

Deep understanding of and empathy for gaming and esports fans, with the ability to view products and services through a fan-centric lens.
Experience working within the esports, traditional sports, entertainment, or media agency industries.
Familiarity with media rights, broadcast production operations, or digital streaming platforms.

Bei uns laufen KI-Agenten im operativen Tagesgeschäft echter Unternehmen. Sie prüfen Rechnungen, ordnen Anfragen ein, monitoren Förderlandschaften. Nicht im Pitch-Deck, nicht im Innovation-Lab, sondern jeden Tag, ergebnisrelevant. Genau dieser Unterschied ist unsere Arbeit: zwischen einer KI, die Demo bleibt, und einer, die produktiv läuft.
Lucid Labs ist ein AI-first Studio, gegründet von Marek Janetzke, der mit Flightright eines der erfolgreichsten Legal-Techs Europas aufgebaut und verkauft hat. Wir arbeiten selbst so, wie wir beraten: mit Claude, Cursor und den jeweils besten Tools im Alltag. Von der Idee bis zum Piloten beim Kunden dauert es bei uns rund eine Woche.

s.h: Der eigentliche Grund für diese Rolle
s.t:
Hier wirst Du AI-native, bevor Du Deinen Abschluss hast. Nicht KI in Hausarbeiten benutzen, sondern echte KI-Lösungen bauen, die bei Unternehmen produktiv laufen. Das ist der Skill, der in den nächsten Jahren entscheidet, wer gefragt ist — und kaum ein Ort bringt ihn Dir schneller bei als ein Team, das jede Woche selbst baut, was es berät. Die meisten Deiner Kommiliton:innen werden ihn in ihrem ersten Job nach dem Studium lernen. Oder auch nicht.
Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die schnell lernt.
Konkret: Du bekommst montags ein Thema, von dem Du nichts verstehst: Förderrecht, Rechnungsprüfung im Anlagenbau, ein n8n-Workflow, den jemand anders halbfertig hinterlassen hat. Bis Mittwoch hast Du genug verstanden, um die richtigen Fragen zu stellen. Bis Freitag steht etwas, das ein Kunde sehen kann.
Wenn Dich das reizt, anstatt Dir Angst zu machen, lies weiter.
Aufgaben
Eigenverantwortung für Teilprojekte in Kundenmandaten, von Discovery bis Go-Live
Aufbau von Agenten- und Automatisierungs-Workflows mit Claude, n8n und unserem internen Stack
Discovery-Recherche: öffentliche Quellen auswerten, Hypothesen prüfen, Briefings für Erstgespräche vorbereiten
Workshops, Statusupdates und Kundenmaterialien vorbereiten. Klar, strukturiert, auf den Punkt
Kundentermine vor Ort oder per Video: mitmoderieren, protokollieren, Next Steps am selben Abend rausschicken
Prozessoptimierung intern wie bei Kunden
Mitarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche hinweg: Beratung, Produkt, Vertrieb, interne Ops
Keine Woche sieht aus wie die andere. Das ist kein Bug, sondern ein extrem spannendes Lernumfeld.
Qualifikation
Was Du mitbringen musst
Laufendes Studium, Fachrichtung offen. BWL, Informatik, Physik, Jura, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen.
Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, Englisch fließend. Kundenkommunikation läuft auf Deutsch, und Du schreibst darin an Geschäftsführer:innen
Du arbeitest bereits ernsthaft mit KI-Tools. Nicht als Suchmaschinenersatz, sondern für Aufgaben, die Du sonst stundenlang selbst gemacht hättest
Du kannst Komplexes einfach erklären, schriftlich und mündlich
Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst mit und sprichst es an, wenn Dir etwas auffällt
Was ausdrücklich nicht nötig ist
Ein Informatikstudium. Die Hälfte unserer besten Automatisierungen wurde von Leuten gebaut, die nie eine Vorlesung dazu gehört haben
Programmierkenntnisse. Prototypen bauen wir mit modernen AI-Tools und ohne Programmierung. Wie das geht, lernst Du bei uns
Beratungs- oder Startup-Erfahrung
Ein fertiges KI-Projekt im Portfolio. Uns interessiert, wie Du denkst, nicht was Du schon gebaut hast
Wir schauen auf die Lernkurve, nicht auf den Startpunkt.
Du passt zu uns, wenn
Du Dich in den letzten zwei Wochen über Deinen eigenen schlechten Output geärgert hast
Du in 30 Minuten ein Memo schreibst, das eine Geschäftsführerin in fünf gelesen hat
Du bei einem neuen Thema nicht fragst „wo fange ich an", sondern schon angefangen hast
Dein letzter Studi-Job Dich entweder gelangweilt oder Dir gezeigt hat, was Du wirklich willst
Diese Rolle ist nichts für Dich, wenn
Du auf eine klar strukturierte Aufgabenliste wartest, statt selbst zu priorisieren
Du bei Kundenpräsentationen lieber Vorlagen ausfüllst, als Inhalte zu hinterfragen
Du KI-Tools als Hilfsmittel siehst und nicht als Kolleg:innen, mit denen Du täglich arbeitest
Du ehrliches Feedback persönlich nimmst, statt es produktiv zu nutzen
Du planbare Wochen brauchst, um gut zu arbeiten

AI-native werden. Du baust den Skill auf, den gerade jede Beratung und jedes Unternehmen sucht — und wendest ihn jede Woche bei echten Kunden an, nicht im Seminarraum.
Direkter Impact. Kein Layer zwischen Dir und den Entscheidern: der Gründer bei uns, die Geschäftsführung beim Kunden. Was Du vorschlägst, wird umgesetzt oder verworfen, nicht archiviert. Das Ergebnis siehst Du innerhalb von Wochen.
Mit Innovation wachsen. Neue Tools landen bei uns nicht in einer Roadmap, sondern noch in derselben Woche in einem echten Projekt. Wer etwas gefunden hat, das funktioniert, zeigt es. Wir verfolgen die Szene täglich, weil das Feld sich schneller bewegt als jeder Weiterbildungsplan.
Tooling ohne Budgetdiskussion. Zugang zu Claude, OpenAI, Cursor und allem, was wir selbst nutzen.
Ein Gründer, der es schon einmal gemacht hat. Marek war Mitgründer von Flightright, bis zum erfolgreichen Exit. Netzwerk in das deutsche Tech- und Gründer-Ökosystem inklusive.
Studienverträglich. Hybrid in Berlin, mittwochs treffen wir uns als Team im EDGE Coworking am Hauptbahnhof. Ansonsten arbeitest Du, wo Du willst. Klausurenphase heißt weniger Stunden, Semesterferien gerne mehr.
Marktgerechte Vergütung.
Unsere Kultur : Ownership statt Micromanagement. Lieber in zwei Wochen eine smarte Wette machen und daraus lernen, als drei Monate etwas polieren, das niemand validiert hat. Wir suchen Leute, die mitdenken, nicht nur mitarbeiten — und das gilt für Werkstudierende genauso wie für alle anderen.
Deshalb behandeln wir Werkstudierende als Talent-Pipeline, nicht als günstige Arbeitskraft. Wer bei uns überzeugt, hat nach dem Studium drei realistische Wege:
Festanstellung als Consultant oder Product Builder zu marktgerechten Konditionen, eine Empfehlung in unser Netzwerk aus Gründerteams, Top-Beratungen und deutschen Tech-Scaleups — oder die eigene Gründung, mit Sparring und gegebenenfalls Angel-Investment aus dem Gründernetzwerk.

s.h: Klingt spannend? Dann schick uns zwei Dinge
s.t:
Deinen Lebenslauf.
Ein Beispiel (max. zwei Absätze): eine Aufgabe, bei der Du mit KI zu einem besseren Ergebnis gekommen bist, als Du es allein geschafft hättest. Dazu den Prompt, den Du benutzt hast — und ein bis zwei Sätze dazu, was beim ersten Versuch nicht funktioniert hat und was Du daraufhin geändert hast.
Der zweite Teil ist uns wichtiger als der erste. Kein Anschreiben nötig.
Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

Intro
Zur gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.
Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.
Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist : Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service gestalten wir den Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis für Menschen mit chronischen Beschwerden so einfach, niedrigschwellig, erschwinglich und sicher wie möglich, und wollen dabei unterstützen, Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Du willst im Venture Development durchstarten und konntest bereits erste Erfahrungen sammeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum und werde ein zentraler Akteur in der Entwicklung eines neuen HealthTech Ventures. Bringe deinen unternehmerischen Geist ein und hilf uns, innovativen Zugang zu Gesundheit zu ermöglichen.
Deine Mission bei uns
Du entdeckst durch Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen ungenutzte Wachstumspotenziale und entwickelst Strategien, um diese Chancen zu nutzen.
Du unterstützt den Aufbau und die Pflege wertvoller Partnerschaften und bist aktiv an der Identifizierung und Umsetzung von Kooperationen beteiligt.
Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Marketing und Sales Strategien, insbesondere für unser Projekt GreenMedical

Help Us Change the Way the World Works
Build something that matters.
Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations.

Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

We're seeking a skilled Partnership Manager to join our team full-time and in person to own our partner ecosystem and drive revenue growth. This role is perfect for someone who wants to work with leading consultancies and system integrators while shaping the commercial future of enterprise AI.
You will be responsible for the entire partner lifecycle – from identifying and recruiting high-potential partners (Boutiques, R/GSIs, Tech Partners) to enabling them to sell and implement Langdock. You will manage our partner tiers (Registered, Certified, Specialist, Expert) and ensure operational excellence.
Timeline After Start

50% of your time: Onboarding and a deep dive into the Langdock platform and our partner ecosystem. You will familiarize yourself with our existing partners, our tier structure, and our operational tools.
50% of your time: Intensive onboarding, product mastery through customer interactions, and helping out in customer support.

You will start managing relationships with existing partners and begin the recruitment process for new key partners. You will also take ownership of partner enablement sessions and start working on joint go-to-market strategies.

You will fully own the partner channel revenue target. You will drive co-sell and resell motions, manage the partner pipeline, and work strategically to expand our ecosystem with high-value consultancies and tech partners.

Build the Ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and manage relationships with key partners, including boutique consultancies, regional & global system integrators, as well as technology partners.
Drive Revenue: Work with partners to generate new business opportunities through referral, co-sell, and resell motions. You will be responsible for achieving revenue targets associated with the partner channel.
Partner Enablement: Ensure partners are equipped to sell and implement Langdock solutions. This includes conducting product and sales enablement sessions, providing marketing materials, and keeping partners updated on our roadmap.
Operational Excellence: Manage the operational aspects of our partnership program, including deal registration, commission payouts, and partner tier management.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with our Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure our partners and mutual customers are successful. Act as the voice of the partner within Langdock.
Strategic Planning: Help refine our partnership strategy, including tier structures, benefits, and requirements, to ensure alignment with our overall company goals.
You Might Be a Fit If…
Relationship Builder: You have built partnerships in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with consultancies or system integrators, and you have a proven track record of building strong, lasting relationships with external stakeholders. You are empathetic and genuine, embodying our value of "Caring Ownership."
Strategic Thinker: You can think strategically about how to leverage partnerships to drive growth. You understand the dynamics of the partner ecosystem and can identify high-value opportunities.
Execution Oriented: You are a self-starter who can take ownership of projects and drive them to completion. You embody our value of "Ambitious Execution" and are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Communication Skills: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, C1 or native in both English and German.
Tech Savvy: You have a good understanding of the software landscape and are comfortable learning new technologies. You are excited about the potential of AI to transform the way we work.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.
The Environment
We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.
Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.
The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.
We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.
Next steps
We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.
If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

NetBox Labs is seeking a Technology Alliances Manager to own and scale our strategic technology ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct business impact and high executive visibility.

You will be the primary relationship owner and joint go-to-market driver for our most strategic technology partners — Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential — with one clear mandate: open doors, drive business, and convert these relationships into revenue-producing routes to market for NetBox Labs, up to and including placement on our partners’ global price lists.
Four of our five priority partners are among the largest technology companies in the world, where executive access is earned, not given.

We’re looking for a sophisticated, alliance professional with relentless energy, initiative, and creativity — someone who builds their own momentum, navigates complex global organizations to reach the executives who matter, and is equally comfortable and productive with a senior leader in São Paulo, Bangalore, or Munich: a true citizen of the world.

Reporting to the Vice President of Global Partnerships, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing — and you will define the objectives and metrics by which NetBox Labs’ executive leadership tracks the alliance program’s progress.

Alliance Strategy & Executive Access
Own the global technology alliance strategy across Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential, ensuring the portfolio aligns with NetBox Labs’ product vision, platform priorities, and go-to-market objectives.
Map the organization, build champions at every level, and convert them into VP- and C-suite sponsorship — these doors do not open by themselves.
Run two motions in parallel: land fast, visible wins with nimble partners like Itential while executing the longer, more complex campaigns required to break through at Cisco, HPE, Arista, and Red Hat.
Define partner tiering, engagement models, and investment levels across the technology alliance portfolio, and identify emerging partnership opportunities in adjacent ecosystems.
Routes to Market & Joint Go-to-Market Execution
Drive NetBox Labs onto partner global price lists and into resale, OEM, and marketplace programs that connect our products to partner sales organizations worldwide.
Design and launch joint GTM programs — co-sell motions, joint solution packaging, co-marketing campaigns, and field enablement — with success measured in programs launched and partner-influenced pipeline.
Build multi-year joint business plans and lead complex commercial engagements, including contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and incentive structures.
Partner with Sales team on account planning, opportunity identification, and co-selling with partner field organizations, and partner with Marketing on co-branded content, joint events, and demand campaigns.
Product & Integration Alignment
Serve as the voice of the partner in internal product planning, ensuring partner integration requirements and joint roadmap opportunities are reflected in NetBox Labs’ priorities.
Work with Engineering and Product to scope and deliver certified integrations and joint solutions that create tangible customer value.
Maintain command of partner platform roadmaps, capabilities, and certification programs, and position NetBox Labs strategically within them.
Executive Metrics & Alliance Governance
Define the objectives, KPIs, and scorecards for the technology alliance program — and build the reporting rhythm that enables NetBox Labs’ executive leadership to track and monitor progress with clarity and confidence.
Establish governance frameworks for each alliance: executive business reviews, partner lifecycle management, performance tracking, and long-range strategic planning sessions.
Report data-driven results to leadership: programs launched, integration adoption, partner-influenced pipeline, and route-to-market milestones such as price-list placement and partner-status achievements.
Cross-Functional & Global Representation
Operate as the internal champion for technology alliances, building simple, repeatable playbooks that help internal teams and partner stakeholders co-sell and co-market effectively.
Represent NetBox Labs at partner summits, industry forums, and ecosystem events worldwide, engaging partner executives across regions, cultures, and time zones.

5-7+ years of experience in technology alliances, business development, or strategic partnerships within enterprise software, SaaS, or infrastructure technology — including direct experience with one or more priority partners (Cisco, Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, HPE, Arista Networks, or similar network infrastructure and automation vendors).
A track record of earning executive sponsorship inside matrixed global organizations and converting it into commercial outcomes — global price list placement, resale or OEM agreements, marketplace listings, or equivalent routes to market.
Self-generated energy, initiative, and creativity: you build your own momentum, hunt for opportunity, and never sit back waiting for the business to come to you.
Demonstrated ability to define alliance objectives, metrics, and scorecards, and to communicate progress to executive leadership in clear, data-driven terms.
Deep domain expertise in network automation, network infrastructure, or IT operations technology — credible with both technical and business audiences at partner organizations.
Demonstrated executive presence and global refinement: culturally fluent, polished, and effective when engaging with senior executives throughout the Americas, APAC, and EMEA.
Proven ability to align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.

Experience with open source ecosystems or community-driven platform businesses; familiarity with network source of truth, IPAM, DCIM, or automation tooling such as Ansible, Nornir, or Terraform.
Background in product management, solutions engineering, or technical pre-sales — fluency in integration architecture discussions.
A successful record in large, complex deal negotiations; experience with hyperscaler marketplaces, global price lists, or channel/alliance programs at major technology vendors.
Understanding of agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or API-first platform architectures and how they are reshaping enterprise infrastructure management.
International experience — living, working, or managing alliances across regions; additional languages are a plus.

Why should you join Proton?

We're on a mission

We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.

s.h: The role as Pharmacy Partnerships Manager
s.t:
This is a senior sales hire and it carries real ownership. You will run the full sales cycle for pharmacy accounts across the UK, from first conversation to signed customer, and you will set the standard for how Pharmlogic sells. As we grow, you help shape the team that grows around you, and we all hold each other to a high standard.
You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a consultative, relationship-led sale into pharmacy owners and groups, won on trust and domain credibility rather than pressure. It suits a full-cycle seller who sources their own pipeline, works without close supervision, and wants to own a function rather than work a list of tasks.
Some of the problems you'll be solving

s.h: As Pharmacy Partnerships Manager, you'll be
s.t:
Building the engine, not just closing deals: Designing and scaling the sales system that takes Pharmlogic from hundreds of pharmacies to thousands. You own the pipeline and the machine that generates it.
Finding the providers ready to grow: Using data intelligently to focus on the pharmacies who stand to gain most from Pharmlogic, independents and multiples alike, and building a repeatable way to reach them at scale.
Selling consultatively, winning on trust: Leading discovery and demonstrations with owners, superintendents and group decision-makers, earning the credibility a healthcare sale is won on.
Owning the number: Carrying a personal revenue target and running your deals end to end, with the autonomy to close them your way.
Setting customers up to win: Owning the handover to onboarding so every pharmacy starts strong and gets full value from day one.
Sharpening how we all sell: Bringing the market back into the room, from events, owners and data, so the whole team gets sharper together, from targeting to pitch to product.
This could be for you, if
You're proven: You've carried a revenue target and hit it, consistently. You're a closer with a track record, not someone who needs the machine built around them first.
You can coach, not just sell: You've mentored or led salespeople and you get energy from making others better. As we grow, the team forms around you, and you're the standard they learn from.
You are fast. Genuinely fast: You move at a pace most people find hard to keep up with. You reply, follow up, and close while others are still planning. Speed is your edge and you know it.
You're fluent with a CRM: You run your pipeline in the tools, not in your head. Clean data, accurate stages, no deal slipping through a crack.
You can forecast: You set targets and call your number with confidence, and you're usually right. You bring commercial clarity, not optimism dressed as a pipeline.
You thrive on pace and ownership: You have a driver's mindset, urgent and resourceful, and you build repeatable things in a fast-moving company rather than waiting for one to exist.
You know the NHS: Experience selling into the NHS or primary care is a strong advantage. Pharmacy specifically is close to ideal. Not essential if everything above is true, but it's a real head start.

You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12–24 months.
Why be a Senior Affiliates & Partnerships Manager at THG Beauty?
We're looking for a Senior Affiliates & Partnerships Manager to take ownership of Cult Beauty's affiliate channel and lead its next phase of growth. This is a hands-on role; you'll set the strategy and own the numbers. You will also be in the detail, planning activations, negotiating placements, managing budgets in real time, and reporting on performance. It suits someone who is equally comfortable building a forecast model as they are briefing a publisher or optimising a live campaign.
You'll own the channel's budget end-to-end, from annual and quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month tracking, reforecasting and reconciliation against actuals, while also executing the campaigns and activations that bring the strategy to life.

You'll use data, including media mix modelling (MMM) and other cross-channel measurement, to understand the channel's true incremental contribution and its role in the wider marketing mix, and you'll look for opportunities for the channel to support broader brand awareness goals, not just direct performance.

s.h: As Senior Affiliates & Partnerships Manager you’ll
s.t:
Channel strategy & scale
Own the affiliate and partnerships strategy for Cult Beauty, identifying and prioritising the highest-value opportunities to scale reach, revenue and new customer acquisition.
Build the channel out from its current base, expanding the partner mix across content, cashback, loyalty, influencer-affiliate and technology partners, while protecting margin and brand value.
Identify and develop opportunities for the channel to support wider brand awareness objectives, working with brand and content teams to use partnerships (e.g. content, video and influencer-affiliate placements) to build reach and consideration alongside direct performance.
Keep the channel's commercial model, commission structure and partner tiering under continuous review, benchmarking against market practice.
Budget planning, forecasting & management
Lead annual and quarterly budget planning and revenue/commission forecasting for the channel, working closely with finance and the wider marketing leadership team.
Own in-month budget management and pacing, tracking spend and commission against forecast, reforecasting as needed, and flagging variances before they become a problem.
Build and maintain robust forecasting models that link activity, seasonality and commercial terms to expected return, and use these to make the case for investment.
Apply media mix modelling (MMM) outputs and other cross-channel measurement to inform budget allocation, understand the channel's incremental contribution, and stress-test planning assumptions against the wider marketing mix.
Reconcile monthly performance against budget and finance records, ensuring accurate, timely reporting on channel P&L.
Activation execution & campaign management
Plan and execute the affiliate activation calendar, from always-on placements through to peak trading moments (e.g. Black Friday, Cyber Monday, key beauty launches) and brand awareness activity.
Brief, negotiate and manage relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, content creators and technology partners to secure high-quality, cost-effective placements.
Own day-to-day channel operations: commission structuring, tracking and validation, compliance, and troubleshooting technical or performance issues.
Use AI-driven tools and optimization, for example automated bid/commission optimisation, AI-assisted content, creative or audience targeting to improve campaign efficiency and free up time for strategic activity.
Data, insight & reporting
Use data to drive decisions across the channel, analysing performance by partner, placement and campaign to identify what's working and reallocate budget accordingly.
Own regular and ad hoc reporting for senior stakeholders, translating channel performance into clear commercial insight and recommendations.
Partner with wider analytics/BI teams to improve attribution, measurement and incrementality understanding for the channel.
Leadership & collaboration
Lead, coach and develop the affiliates team, setting clear priorities and creating capacity to scale as the channel grows.
Act as the primary point of contact for the affiliates channel with cross-functional teams, including brand, finance and commercial, ensuring alignment on priorities and investment.
Collaborate closely with other marketing channels, including paid social, PR, influencer and CRM to align messaging, avoid duplication of partner relationships, and ensure affiliate activity is planned as part of an integrated, cross-channel marketing calendar.
Represent Cult Beauty externally with networks, agencies and partners, building a reputation as a commercially sharp, collaborative partner.

s.h: What skills and experience do I need for this role?
s.t:
Proven experience managing an affiliate/partnerships channel in a fast-paced e-commerce, retail or beauty environment, ideally at Manager level or above already.
Strong data acumen: confident building and interrogating models in Excel/Google Sheets, comfortable working across GA4/BI tools and media mix modelling (MMM) or cross-channel measurement outputs, and able to translate data into a clear commercial story.
Demonstrable experience owning a budget end-to-end: annual/quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month management, pacing and reconciliation with finance.

You are the first human a London landlord speaks to. We generate the demand — paid inbound, portal activity, lead ads pre-qualified by our own AI agent, cold email, leaflets, referrals — and you turn it into signed instructions.
Landlords rarely arrive asking for a named product; they arrive with a problem — an agent they've had enough of, a property they can't get to, a tenancy they don't want to run. Your first job is to work out which of our services solves it, and say so. Valuations, viewings, photography and key handovers sit with operations, so your day is conversations, offers and closes.
This is one role across four rungs, levelled on the scope you own rather than years served. At BDC you work the company lead feeds from the desk: qualify, put a number in front of the landlord, close instructions across the range. At Senior BDC you take the harder pipeline — portfolios, agent switches, the deals that need pricing judgement.

At BDM you own the close, the price and the commercials, with your own sourcing on top of the feeds. At Senior BDM you carry the largest number and own retention.
What you'll own
The first call. Every new lead lands as a task with your name on it. You call it the day it lands, and you get to the landlord's real constraint — money, distance or hassle — before you pitch anything.
The routing decision. DIY, Placed, Managed or Secured — you decide which tier fits the property and the landlord, and you answer for the ones routed wrong.
The number. A figure is the hook; a brochure isn't. You give the landlord what they'd achieve and what they'd take home on each route — and you answer the two objections that lose deals on the same call: price (net income across the whole term, not a headline rent) and trust ("is this rent-to-rent", "will I get my property back" — answered from the agreement).
Your pipeline, in the CRM. Outcome logged, lead status set, next step dated — before you finish the call. A lead with no next step is a lead we've lost.
The close and the price. First conversation → assessment → offer → signed agreement, without being chased through it, then the renter offers that decide what the property actually lets for. You recommend the figure and defend it, knowing the company lives with it for the full term.
The commercials, and your own sourcing. Fee, term and let price on a Managed instruction; the spread on a Secured one. You answer for what the deal earns, not just that it closed. Company feeds are a floor: portfolio landlords, agent switches and referrers you build yourself sit on top.
Senior BDM: retention. Re-signing a landlord is worth more than finding a new one. You own the renewal number and the save.
How we sell
We sell the outcome, not the product. Rent that arrives, a tenancy that runs itself, compliance that never lands on the landlord — then route to the tier that delivers it and price it properly.
We're honest — about the trade and about what we're on the hook for. Every tier asks something of the landlord and gives something back. No subletting, no company lets, no short lets; the landlord stays the landlord. Said plainly, that wins more than overselling — and filters out the price-shoppers who are our biggest single loss reason.
We price on evidence. Comparables, condition, void risk and the renter market decide the figure — not how badly you want the instruction — and nothing gets promised that the valuation won't support.
AI does the prep, you do the selling. Property and market research, call notes, follow-up drafts and pipeline hygiene are increasingly automated. We expect you to use that, not to type around it.

Experience.
BDC: ~1-2 years in a target-driven, phone-led sales role.
BDM / Senior BDM: ~2+ years closing your own deals — consistently at or above quota, with a number you can evidence.
Lettings or BTR instruction-winning strongly preferred; estate agency or another consultative, high-volume sales background considered.
Grit and a desire to win. You make the last call of the day sound like the first, and a bad week makes you dial more, not less.
You run your own pipeline properly — dated next steps, clean CRM, nothing dropped — and you can cold-call without warming up first.
Current lettings market and the regulation around it, including what the Renters' Rights Act changed for voids, notices and renewals, or you can learn it inside a month.
BDC: you can work a company lead feed at volume and handle a "no" in one move.
Senior BDC: a record of closing in a complex, priced product, and of lifting the reps around you.
BDM: commercial judgement on price — you can hold a figure, walk away from a bad one, and explain both — and you self-source: given a patch and a phone, you build pipeline.
Senior BDM: you've carried the largest number on a desk and owned renewals or retention.

Guaranteed rent, rent-to-rent or corporate lettings — including knowing why we're structured differently.
Portfolio landlord, block or relocation-agency relationships in London.
HubSpot, or another CRM you ran properly rather than tolerated, and comfort with your own reporting.
Being early on a desk that then scaled.
Who does well here
You want to win. You count your own numbers, you know where you sit on the desk, and being behind bothers you until it isn't true any more.
You call. The best rep here isn't the most articulate one, it's the one who dials.
You'd rather lose fast than write a bad deal. A maybe you nurse costs a week; a mispriced property is a multi-year problem.
You protect the margin as if it were yours, on the landlord side and the renter side.
Why apply
You'll be a critical human in an AI-Native company optimised for efficiency. We believe homes will be run more efficiently and at a higher quality for customers with AI, and we're building the platform that will run all rental properties end-to-end, starting with London.
We've raised a $4m pre-seed from investors who've built the financial and operational infrastructure that moves billions and serves millions. They backed us because the home is the largest consumer asset where that infrastructure hasn't been built yet. You'll get competitive base pay, meaningful equity, and a small, high-agency team rebuilding an industry and growing at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to facilitate this aggressive growth.
Bonus is uncapped. Hit target and you take home your OTE; beat it and there is no ceiling.

Your mission Everyone's talking about AI. We decide how it actually gets used across the company.
A $400 billion market. A profitable scale-up rethinking it with AI and a global freelance network. And in the middle of it, a team that doesn't primarily write code - it decides what AI should actually deliver: for more than 25,000 Talents in over 70 countries, through automation and smarter processes.
We're looking for you as a Working Student (f/m/d) Strategy & Business Development for our cross-functional strategic taskforce, based at our headquarters in Munich-Schwabing. You'll work at the intersection of strategy, business and AI - as a sparring partner for AI engineers, product and operations experts, and a former BCG consultant. Not as another engineer on the team, but as the person who makes sure the team builds the right thing.
This isn't a typical working student role for techies. You'll structure problems, build business cases, evaluate AI applications from a business perspective, and translate between what's technically possible and what's strategically right. The concepts you work on don't end up in a drawer - they get prototyped, discussed, and feed directly into our leadership team's decisions.
What You'll Actually Do AI strategy, not AI code: You'll work on strategic AI initiatives like our Talent Assistant or AutoQA 2.0 (AI-based voice file analysis) - not as a developer, but as someone who structures requirements, sets priorities, and turns early ideas into solid feature concepts. Our AI engineers handle the technical build; you make sure they're building the right thing.
Ideas become decisions: You'll analyze complex questions, build business cases using classic case logic, and develop decision-making material for our leadership team. Your analysis directly influences which AI initiatives get greenlit.
AI needs structure: Large language models are only as good as the data behind them. You'll define competency frameworks and evaluation logic that make our AI systems smarter - the content logic, not the technical implementation.
Your own projects, real ownership: You'll independently own topics from first analysis to first concept - a new AI use case, a workflow that's still manual today, an automation, a new approach. The content changes; the standard doesn't. You get responsibility, not just tasks.
Working where the leverage is highest: You'll support the team wherever the most interesting strategic questions are emerging right now. That means variety, high speed, and visible impact.
Why This Role Will Accelerate Your Growth
Here, you won't learn to code - you'll learn how to evaluate AI investments, build business cases that hold up in front of leadership, and structure complex topics so they turn into measurable business impact. It's the exact craft you'll later need in strategy consulting or corporate strategy - except here, the recommendation actually gets implemented instead of ending up in a slide deck.
You'll work closely with a former BCG consultant, AI engineers, and product experts, moving daily between strategy, business judgment, and AI.
Our last working student in this role went on to join us as a trainee - not because we promise it, but because she'd already taken on real responsibility during her time with us.
Your skillset Academic background: You're currently pursuing a Master's degree (business administration, economics, industrial engineering, or comparable) and already bring some practical experience - ideally with a strategic or analytical focus.
AI-savvy, not an AI engineer: You don't need to code or build models. But you use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as a power user for research, analysis, and structuring - and you understand how AI changes business processes. More important than deep technical knowledge: you can identify what problem an AI use case is actually meant to solve.
Skills: You structure complex issues cleanly and are confident enough in PowerPoint and Excel to put together compelling management presentations and business cases.
Mindset: You don't wait for someone to explain the next step. You dig into new topics on your own, think entrepreneurially, and want to develop solutions rather than just work through tasks.
Language skills: You communicate and present fluently in German and English, and naturally bring a healthy sense of humor.
Availability: You have 16–20 hours per week during the semester to work on-site at our Munich headquarters, with flexible scaling up to full-time during semester breaks.
Your winning deal Your opportunity: From day one, you'll contribute to one of the company's most strategic AI initiatives and help build solutions that improve the daily work of thousands of people.
Your mentor: Work closely with a former BCG consultant who will coach, challenge, and support your development.
Your network: Collaborate every day with AI Engineers, Product, Strategy, and Operations experts - exposure that's rarely found in traditional working student roles.
Your future: A full-time Trainee position after graduation is explicitly possible and has already become reality several times within our team.
Your benefits: Enjoy weekly pizza and snacks at the office, a lunch allowance (€ 6.90 x 4 per month), subsidized Wellpass membership, discounts through Corporate Benefits, and fantastic team and company events.

Our culture: An open, authentic environment and a high-performing, humorous team that looks forward to making bold decisions and exploring new ideas together.

Represent the company at key maritime conferences, trade shows, and events, ensuring visibility and senior leader alignment.
Identify and shape new opportunities in surface warfare mission areas such as combat systems integration, electronic warfare, sensors, autonomy, and C5ISR.

Business Development Team Lead (m/w/d)
B2B SaaS | Berlin | Leadership & Outbound Sales
Für ein stark wachsendes, international tätiges B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen suchen wir im Rahmen eines exklusiven Suchmandats einen Business Development Team Lead (m/w/d) für den Standort Berlin.
Das Unternehmen befindet sich in einer dynamischen Wachstumsphase und baut seine kommerzielle Organisation weiter aus. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Business-Development-Team und entwickelst dieses sowohl operativ als auch strategisch weiter.
Gesucht wird dabei ausdrücklich kein rein administrativer Team Lead. Du solltest aus dem Outbound Sales kommen, erfolgreiche Vertriebsansätze selbst angewendet haben und in der Lage sein, diese Erfahrung sehr praxisnah an dein Team weiterzugeben.
Deine Aufgabe
Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams von Business Development Representatives und entwickelst dieses zu einer leistungsstarken Outbound-Organisation weiter.
Dabei gehören insbesondere folgende Themen zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich:
Leadership & Coaching: Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst deine BDRs kontinuierlich weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre individuellen Ziele zu erreichen und perspektivisch den nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen.
Hands-on Sales Coaching: Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team im Tagesgeschäft, analysierst Calls und Outreach-Aktivitäten und vermittelst konkrete Methoden und Best Practices aus deiner eigenen Vertriebserfahrung.
Performance Management: Du steuerst das Team anhand relevanter KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Qualität und Produktivität ab.
Outbound Excellence: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Prospecting-Ansätze, Messaging, Playbooks und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
Teamaufbau: Du unterstützt bei Recruiting und Onboarding neuer BDRs und stellst sicher, dass neue Teammitglieder schnell produktiv werden.
Sales Strategy: Du arbeitest eng mit dem weiteren Sales Leadership sowie angrenzenden Teams zusammen und übersetzt Markt- und Kundenfeedback in wirkungsvolle Akquisitionsstrategien.
Customer Focus: Du stellst sicher, dass das Team trotz hoher Outbound-Aktivität einen professionellen, beratenden und kundenorientierten Vertriebsansatz verfolgt.
Was du mitbringen solltest
Wir suchen eine Person mit einem starken operativen Sales-Background und erster bzw. fundierter Führungserfahrung in einem ambitionierten B2B-Vertriebsumfeld.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Business Development / Sales Development / Outbound Sales
Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise in SaaS, Tech oder einem vergleichbar dynamischen Geschäftsmodell
Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, Coaching oder in der Führung von SDR-/BDR-Teams
Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Outbound-Methoden und Sales-Prozesse
Erfahrung mit KPI- und datenbasierter Vertriebssteuerung
Ausgeprägte Coaching-Mentalität und Freude daran, andere Vertriebler besser zu machen
Fähigkeit, eigene Sales-Erfahrung in konkrete Methoden, Playbooks und Trainings zu übersetzen
Hoher Qualitätsanspruch bei gleichzeitig pragmatischer und umsetzungsorientierter Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
Was die Rolle besonders macht
Die Position bietet deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum als eine klassische Team-Lead-Rolle.
Du übernimmst ein Team in einer wichtigen Wachstumsphase und kannst unmittelbar beeinflussen, wie Outbound Sales organisiert, gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird . Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit dem Management und der kommerziellen Führung des Unternehmens zusammen.
Die Rolle eignet sich besonders für jemanden, der weiterhin nah am operativen Vertrieb bleiben möchte und Spaß daran hat, ein Team nicht nur zu managen, sondern durch Coaching, Struktur und eigene Sales-Erfahrung messbar besser zu machen .
Das Unternehmen
Unser Mandant ist ein wachstumsstarkes europäisches Technologieunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin. Das Unternehmen bietet eine B2B-Softwarelösung für mittelständische Unternehmen und hat sich in den vergangenen Jahren erfolgreich in mehreren europäischen Märkten etabliert.
Das internationale Team arbeitet in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und einer ausgeprägten Ownership-Kultur.
Rahmenbedingungen
Standort: Berlin

Rolle: Führungsverantwortung für ein Business-Development-Team
Umfeld: Internationales B2B-SaaS-/Tech-Unternehmen in einer starken Wachstumsphase
Direkte Zusammenarbeit: mit dem Sales Leadership und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern

Your purpose at Kertos
Als Channel Sales Manager übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für den Partnerkanal von Kertos – von der Pipeline bis zum Umsatz. Du baust das Ökosystem von Grund auf auf: du entscheidest, welche Partner wir angehen, gewinnst sie und machst aus diesen Beziehungen eine verlässliche, messbare Wachstumsquelle. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Marketing und Product zusammen, damit Partnerschaften kein Silo bilden, sondern echten Impact im gesamten Unternehmen erzeugen.
Auf- und Ausbau des Partnerkanals mit belastbaren, vertrauensbasierten Beziehungen zu Key-Partnern – mit dem Ziel, Umsatzwachstum zu treiben und Partner- und Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.
Rekrutierung und Onboarding kommerzieller Partner, darunter Reseller und MSSPs, sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Partner-Go-to-Market-Strategie.
Entwicklung skalierbarer Prozesse zur Gewinnung, Aktivierung und langfristigen Betreuung strategischer Partner – damit das Programm strukturiert und nachhaltig wächst.
Konzeption und Durchführung von Partner-Enablement-Programmen, Webinaren und Trainings, die Partner in die Lage versetzen, Kertos selbstständig und überzeugend bei ihren Kunden zu positionieren.
Aufbau eines nachhaltigen Partner-Ökosystems, das qualifizierte Leads bei Endkunden generiert und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erschließt.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Product und Sales, um Partnerinitiativen mit den Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und den Partnerkanal konsequent weiterzuentwickeln.
The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring
Du hast nachweislich Partnerprogramme im B2B SaaS-Umfeld aufgebaut oder wesentlich mitgestaltet – idealerweise in einem Startup oder Scale-up.
Du hast einen Hintergrund im Channel Sales mit einer quota-carrying Rolle und hast langjährige Erfahrung darin, wie Pipeline über Partner generiert und Deals gewonnen werden.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und lieferst Ergebnisse, auch wenn kein Playbook existiert – das ist dein bevorzugtes Umfeld, nicht dein Problem.
Deine Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten auf Entscheiderebene sind auf Deutsch und Englisch gleichermaßen stark.
Erfahrung in der Compliance-, Cybersecurity- oder Legal-Tech-Branche ist ein echtes Plus – du weißt, wer unsere Kunden sind und welche Partner für sie relevant sind.
Du misst deinen Erfolg an Partnership-sourced Pipeline und ARR.
Why Kertos
Dein Erfolg ist unser Erfolg : Du partizipierst am Unternehmenserfolg durch unseren Virtual Share Incentive Plan (VSIP)
Cutting Edge AI Technologie : Führende VCs haben in unsere Vision und nachhaltiges Wachstum investiert, damit wir nachhaltig verändern, wie Compliance-Maßnahmen gehandhabt werden
Großer Impact : Bei uns bekommst du Verantwortung ab Tag 1, arbeitest selbstständig an Themen und bringst so Kertos richtig voran

Regelmäßiges Feedback : Wir leben eine offene Feedbackkultur und unterstützen dich bei deinem Wachstum mit regelmäßigen 1-1s, 360 Grad Feedback, Schulungen und einem Top Netzwerk von Expert*innen

Keep growing : Um deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung zu unterstützen, stellen wir dir ein jährliches Budget von 1.500€ zur Verfügung
Volle Flexibilität : Ob im Münchner Hauptquartier, Berliner Büro oder aus dem Homeoffice – wir sind flexibel und du happy
